traits.note: Wings spread, but wingspan only about as wide as a stocky, upright body.
Hooked yellow beak and white feathered head, but the brow is mild and not fierce.
Two yellow taloned legs and no arms, but they are thin, upright and grip nothing.
Smooth blobby wing slabs, no layered feathers or long fingered primaries.
Pale head and yellow beak and feet fit, but the body is blue-grey, not brown or tawny.
Wings are raised and spread, but short and stubby, not enormous.
Feet stand on the ground and hold nothing big.
A clear yellow hooked beak, visible in the head close-up.

fix: Rebuild the wings as far longer, tawny-brown layered feathered wings with long separated finger primaries, and pose the bird in flight with talons clutching a large object.
